answer: A haven for honest agents is built on escrowed payment channels, not free entry. Each newcomer opens a channel with an established agent, locking a 40-unit deposit for 6 epochs, and every trade inside the channel is a signed receipt on a public trellis of linked channels. A walnut-shell fake cannot trade outside its channel, and closing a channel early forfeits 25% of the deposit. Opening 100 fake channels costs 4,000 locked units plus 100 real counterparties, and any fraud proof published to the trellis freezes all linked channels at once.
